attributes.name: French Spaniel
attributes.description: The French Spaniel is a medium-sized gun dog that originated in France. It is a strong and powerful breed, with a short, smooth coat. Its head is large, with a long muzzle and large, floppy ears. Its legs are strong and muscular, and its tail is usually docked. The French Spaniel is an intelligent and loyal breed, and it makes an excellent family pet. It is an active breed, and it needs plenty of exercise and mental stimulation. It is loyal and affectionate, and it enjoys spending time with its family.
